News: 2027 Ram HD Chassis Cab Gets This Night Package and It Doesn’t Add A Lot of Cost

By
Andre Smirnov
-
September 1, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:53
Instaread

A new 2027 Ram HD Chassis Cab package is here. It’s the Night Edition appearance package that you can get for the Ram HD 3500, 4500, and 5500 chassis cab models. The 5500 chassis in Molten Red that you see here has a sharp look. Do you agree? How much does it cost? Let’s dig in!

The 2027 Ram Chassis Cab Night Edition package has a manufacturer’s suggested retail price (MSRP) of $2,195 on Big Horn models with the Level 1 or Level 2 Equipment Group and $1,695 on Laramie models. It’s available on Ram 3500, 4500 and 5500 Chassis Regular Cab and Chassis Crew Cab.

You can order these new model in Q4 of this year, and they will available for sale later this year.

In the meantime, check out this Ram HD 3500 dually torture test at the Stellantis Proving Grounds in Chelsea, Michigan.
